purpose: Define the smallest headless interface by which System Master Chat can invoke and display Learning work while Learning retains learner, curriculum, assessment, mastery, adaptation and Learning-evidence semantics.

learning_owns: attempt scoring through independent behavior oracles
forbidden_transfers: Core does not calculate or overwrite mastery
Chat text does not self-authorize correctness
generic artifact success does not become Learning PASS
Learning does not mutate Book, Documents or Programming state

versioning.compatibility_rule: Additive optional fields are backward compatible; changes to command meaning, state transition authority, scoring authority or evidence classification require a new major version and fresh qualification.

commands.rule: Progress is descriptive durable state only; it does not infer effectiveness.
Learning selects the next valid node; Core cannot override prerequisites or evidence gates.
Only the Learning-owned oracle decides correctness; PRACTICE cannot count as mastery.
A check cannot be served before its durable delay/evidence gate.
Artifact availability is not curriculum completion or mastery.
Cancellation is best-effort and cannot rewrite already-admitted evidence.

concurrency_and_idempotency.mutation_precondition: expected_learning_state_version must equal the live Learning-owned version
concurrency_and_idempotency.replay_rule: Same key and same canonical input returns the original result; same key with different canonical input fails closed.
concurrency_and_idempotency.cross_course_parallelism: Allowed only when no shared Learning-state invariant is touched.

privacy_and_human_boundary.default_data_minimization: Do not place raw learner responses in cross-system telemetry. Return stable evidence references and bounded feedback.

failure_injection_and_tests: duplicate ATTEMPT_SUBMIT with identical idempotency key returns original result without a second state transition
same idempotency key with changed response fails closed
Core-supplied correctness flag is ignored and rejected
RETENTION_CHECK_REQUEST before due time returns NOT_DUE
missing consent/evidence policy rejects admission of real learner evidence
transport timeout after commit is recoverable by idempotent replay
Book, Documents, Programming and retired-Prose identifiers cannot be targeted as Learning state
completion_delta: A concrete owner-preserving command/event/state contract now exists for headless System Master integration; no runtime adapter, product admission or Learning completion is claimed.
evidence_target: Portable contract/schema tests followed by an exact-SHA hosted adapter qualification on a fresh integration subject.
stop_condition: Stop this contract unit when ownership, schemas, commands, state concurrency, idempotency, privacy, evidence classes, failure modes and qualification targets are explicit enough for bounded implementation.
forbidden_authority: may not mutate Learning semantics from Core
may not write Book, Documents or Programming canonical state
may not create retired Prose work
continuation_rule: After Batch 06 semantic PASS and ordinal-7 continuation are unblocked, Learning prioritizes the ordered curriculum compiler. Otherwise, an owner-valid successor may implement only the transport-neutral schemas and portable contract tests on a fresh exact subject.
